product_title: Handcrafted Rose Gold Decorative Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Enhance your festive decor with this elegant handcrafted set featuring vibrant red roses, intricate golden detailing, sparkling mirror accents, and delicate pearl embellishments. Perfect for Diwali, pooja decor, festive tables, and special occasions.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep artificial flowers and embellishments away from direct heat.
Use LED tealights for safer lighting, or keep open flames away from flowers and decorative elements.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
